channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. And at noon and Sundays, we take you beyond the headlines to help make sense of what everyone is talking about in politics and beyond with One Thing.

item.title: Elon Musk Pledges SpaceX Shares to Every US Kid
item.description: Early voting kicks off in Texas while President Donald Trump is starting his midterm campaign blitz. The Supreme Court backs the Pentagon’s decision to throw out plea deals for the alleged conspirators of 9/11. Elon Musk vows to give each American child a SpaceX share—a promise worth billions of dollars. Plus, President Trump signs an executive order that creates a women’s health task force. item.title: The Swing Voters that Could Define the Midterms (And Beyond)
item.itunes:title: The Swing Voters that Could Define the Midterms (And Beyond)
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
After President Donald Trump and the Republican Party made gains with Latino voters in 2024, polling suggests that support is evaporating. We look at where that is most evident on the midterm map and what it could mean for this crucial voting bloc moving forward.

--- 

Guest: Eric Bradner, CNN National Political Reporter 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: Can Erik Prince's Mercenary Operation Solve Haiti's Gang Crisis?
item.itunes:title: Can Erik Prince's Mercenary Operation Solve Haiti's Gang Crisis?
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Years of gang-fueled violence have left Haiti in disrepair, killing thousands and displacing over a million people. Now an American military contractor thinks he has a solution. CNN got exclusive access to an anti-gang operation led by US security tycoon Erik Prince to see what he is proposing and whether Haitians welcome his involvement. 

Watch more here: Haiti’s drone war 

--- 

Guests: Nick Paton Walsh, CNN Chief International Security Correspondent & Caitlin Hu, CNN International News Reporting Director 

Host: David Rind 

Producer: Paola Ortiz 

Showrunner: Felicia Patinkin

item.title: “It’s Like a Sisterhood”: Two Colleagues Face Breast Cancer Together
item.itunes:author: CNN Podcasts
item.content:encoded:
Two cancer care professionals became patients themselves – and discovered just how powerful their friendship could be. Why a church parking lot could be your next home. A 2026 CNN Hero who once relied on food pantries is reimagining how Chicago families get the food they need. A 2024 study estimated that 52 million Americans struggle with loneliness – find out what CNN learned from experts about how to combat that. Plus, how a scheduling shakeup turned into a big win for fans at this year's WNBA Finals. 

Host/Producer: Krista Bo Polanco 

Producer: Eryn Mathewson  

Senior Producer: Felicia Patinkin 

Editorial Support: Kathleen Toner, Samantha Delouya, Don Riddell

item.title: Trump Fires WH Press Secretary
